name: SheConnects
audience: Rural women micro-entrepreneurs and women in trade in Isiolo and Marsabit counties.
outcomes: Meaningful digital adoption; onboarding women onto e-commerce and digital platform tools; unlocking digital financial and marketing inclusion.
duration: 15 months
delivery: Mobile-first tools (HerVenture app) plus localised training networks.

name: CASHA — Creating Shared Value with Young People in the Livestock Sector in Kenya's Arid and Semi-Arid Lands
heroSubtitle: Creating Shared Value with Young People in the Livestock Sector in Kenya's Arid and Semi-Arid Lands
audience: Unemployed pastoralist youth and young women aged 18–35, including refugees and persons with disabilities, across 15 Kenyan ASAL counties.
outcomes: Target of 200,000 dignified and fulfilling jobs; climate-smart agri-entrepreneurship; long-term financial inclusion.
duration: 5 years
delivery: Consortium-led livestock skills, enterprise development, financial access and market linkage support.

name: KCB Mifugo ni Mali
reach: Garissa, Isiolo, Samburu, Lamu & Tana River
audience: Pastoralist communities, Farmer Producer Organisations and livestock cooperatives in Garissa, Isiolo, Samburu, Lamu and Tana River.
outcomes: Digital herd tracking (RFID); hydroponic fodder infrastructure; KCB asset financing and export offtake pipelines.
duration: 12 months
delivery: Field-based cooperative development, AgTech deployment, financial preparation and offtake linkage.
journey: Aug–Oct Financial Literacy & KCB Credit Prep

name: Investor Readiness Program
audience: Growth-stage SMEs across all sectors in Kenya raising commercial, impact or equity capital.
outcomes: Investor-readiness status; compliance-vetted financial models; direct pitch pipelines to active funding networks.
duration: 8 weeks
delivery: Hybrid: digital LMS modules, weekly 1-on-1 expert advisory, peer breakout cohorts.

name: Export Readiness Program
audience: Growth-stage women-led SMEs and female founders with stable domestic traction, scaling into regional or international markets.
outcomes: Export-compliance certification; gender-inclusive cross-border logistics; direct links to international buyers and female-focused trade finance.
duration: 3 months plus a hands-on exporting workshop
delivery: Hybrid: trade-compliance LMS, weekly 1-on-1 export advisory, peer accountability circles for women founders.

name: Webinar Series
audience: Growth-stage SMEs, mainly women entrepreneurs, institutionalising their internal operating structures.
outcomes: Formal internal operating set-ups; regulatory and statutory compliance; digital workflows; investor readiness.
duration: Continuous, recurring yearly; webinars once or twice a month
delivery: Interactive virtual webinars, downloadable templates and toolkits, virtual Q&A clinics.

name: HerVenture — Mobile Learning App
heroSubtitle: Mobile learning app for women entrepreneurs
audience: Women micro-entrepreneurs.
outcomes: Rapid digital adoption; foundational business literacy (marketing, bookkeeping, cash flow); moving micro operations into formal businesses.
duration: Self-paced year-round, plus 3–6 months of active SRC cohort support
delivery: Kiswahili HerVenture app with bite-sized offline modules, reinforced by virtual and field training circles.

name: Road to Markets
audience: Established women-led MSMEs in Kenya, operating 3+ years, scaling their geographic or digital footprint.
outcomes: A structured 6–12-month market growth plan; cross-border trade and border compliance; links to regional corporate procurement.
duration: 6 months, about 10 hours/month
delivery: 3 months of masterclasses plus 3 months of mentoring and market placement.

name: Road to Growth
audience: Growth-stage women founders of registered SMEs facing structural or financial barriers to growth.
outcomes: Business management skills; financial literacy; peer accountability networks; investment readiness.
duration: 7-week intensive accelerator
delivery: Blended: online training, physical masterclasses, group coaching.

name: LIFT-NK — Livelihoods and Inclusion for Transformation, Northern Kenya
heroSubtitle: Livelihoods and Inclusion for Transformation – Northern Kenya
audience: Vulnerable women, youth and refugees in extreme poverty in forest-adjacent areas and refugee settlements in Northern Kenya.
outcomes: 3,650+ green micro-enterprises; investor readiness for 4,000 growing businesses; 93,000+ people lifted out of extreme poverty.
duration: August 2022 – December 2025
delivery: Green enterprise training, seed funding, business bootcamps and market integration.

name: Kuza Jamii I & II
audience: Ultra-poor and vulnerable pastoralist households, women, youth and refugees.
outcomes: Graduating households from cash-transfer dependency into climate-resilient businesses; financial inclusion; stronger government social-protection delivery.
duration: Phase I: 12 months · Phase II: 6-month bridging
dates: Phase I Apr 2024 – Mar 2025; Phase II late 2025 – Mar 2026
delivery: Consortium-led graduation, social-protection and enterprise support.

name: SEED — Sustainable Entrepreneurship and Economic Development
audience: Unemployed pastoralist youth and young women aged 18–34 in Marsabit and Isiolo, with a strict 50/50 gender balance.
outcomes: 800+ youth-led green enterprises; certified community business mentors (Training-of-Trainers); financial independence for 2,400 youth.
duration: 12-month accelerated lifecycle
delivery: Community mobilisation, business skills, seed capital and peer mentorship.

name: Investor Readiness for Waste & Circular Economy SMEs
heroSubtitle: For waste, recycling and circular-economy SMEs, with ANDE
audience: Small and growing businesses and green SMEs in waste management, recycling and the circular economy.
outcomes: Eco-enterprises structured into corporations; financial discipline; direct investor matchmaking for green capital.
duration: 12–18 months in successive cohorts
delivery: Virtual technical assistance, investment preparation and investor matchmaking.

name: Investor Readiness for Women Entrepreneurs
audience: Growth-oriented African women running established SMEs who want to scale.
outcomes: Investor readiness; access to corporate supply chains; job creation.
duration: 10 months (5 months of training + 5 months of mentorship aftercare)
delivery: Virtual training, mentorship aftercare and corporate market linkage.

name: Road to Leadership
audience: Growth-oriented Kenyan women entrepreneurs and SME owners moving from day-to-day operations into strategic business leadership.
outcomes: Overcoming imposter syndrome, mastering the executive elevator pitch, building contract negotiation and self-advocacy skills, and a lifelong network of female business peers.
duration: 3–4-week cohort
delivery: Fully digital: live virtual masterclasses, peer breakout circles and personal assessment workbooks.

name: Palladium (USAID-funded) Project
audience: High-growth agribusinesses (processors, aggregators, input suppliers) in livestock, dairy, horticulture and clean energy, with an emphasis on women- and youth-led enterprises; also local banks and financial institutions.
outcomes: Over $630 million in private capital mobilised; banks shifting from rigid collateral to cash-flow lending; a sustainable network of local financial advisory firms.
duration: Multi-year; each business goes through a 6–12-month capital matching and transaction cycle.
delivery: Market-driven model with pay-for-performance incentives for advisors, Opportunities Teams preparing demand and Investment Teams de-risking supply.
journey: Investment Prep (SRC-led governance and pitch building)

name: SME Loop in Kenya
audience: 75 micro, small and medium enterprises and young enterprises in Kajiado and Machakos, focused on youth-led businesses.
outcomes: Stronger entrepreneurial skills, direct financial linkages, better access to financial services and stronger policy framework conditions.
duration: Multi-month cohort cycle using the GIZ SME Loop methodology.
delivery: Implemented by SRC on behalf of GIZ: classroom business development services combined with on-site, sector-specific coaching.

name: GIZ Business Scouts for Development
audience: Established manufacturing SMEs in Kenya and Uganda in food/agri-processing and cosmetics/beauty, ready to automate or expand regionally.
outcomes: Asset financing for machinery, optimised production floors, KEBS/UNBS standards compliance, and cross-border B2B market access.
duration: 6–9-month incubation and acceleration track with multi-day technical sprints.
delivery: Hybrid, factory-focused: virtual training, 1-on-1 on-site industrial consulting, cross-border B2B matching and manufacturing financial modelling.

name: Village Capital BDS Services Program
audience: A cohort of 10 rural-impacting enterprises (aggregators, off-grid solar, last-mile distributors) and the enterprise support organisations that serve them.
outcomes: Ventures moved onto an objective milestone framework, operational gaps identified to guide business support, local hubs audited, and real community impact measured.
duration: 3–6-month tracking and diagnostic lifecycle with multi-week milestone checkpoints.
delivery: Built around Village Capital's ABACA diagnostic tool (Levels 1–9), with on-site field data collection and data-driven coaching.

name: USAID / ACDI/VOCA Livestock Markets Project
audience: 56 selected SMEs and livestock markets: veterinary suppliers, fodder producers, aggregators and Livestock Market Associations.
outcomes: Livestock yards upgraded into self-sustaining commercial hubs, transport chains optimised to cut transit weight loss, bookkeeping systems, commercial bank loans and local branding.
duration: Multi-year; each enterprise cohort goes through a 6–12-month acceleration track.
delivery: On-site advisory at enterprise premises, public-private co-management of sale yards, dryland climate risk analysis and deal matching with meat exporters.

name: Netherlands Trust Fund III (NTF III) East Africa IT & ITES Programme
audience: 28 Kenyan and 25 Ugandan tech entrepreneurs (software developers, BPOs, digital start-ups) plus corporate buyers, telcos and tier-1 banks.
outcomes: Cross-border tech outsourcing contracts, global standards for data security and IP protection, regional sub-contracting alliances and standard offshore pricing.
duration: Multi-year; 6–12-month export coaching track with 3–5-day B2B matchmaking events.
delivery: National coordination led by SRC: curated 1-on-1 deal rooms, technical portfolio prep and cross-border collaboration workshops.
